description: Create a new primary IP with the specified type, optional location, and optional assignee type.

assignee_id.description: Server ID to assign the primary IP to (create-and-assign in one call)

assignee_type.description: Assignee type. Optional since 2026-04-27; defaults to "server" until 2026-08-01, then to "unassigned".

auto_delete.description: Delete the primary IP when the assignee is deleted

name: hetzner_create_primary_ip
title: Create Primary IP
